title: New York City green-taxi trips in 2025
question: How do trip characteristics relate to travel time and demand across zones and periods?
publisher: New York City Taxi and Limousine Commission
measurement_dates: All 12 calendar months of 2025, retained as the agency's current frozen snapshot.
variables_and_units: Variables and units are preserved in native column headers, instrument metadata and source dictionaries; see evidence anchors below.
independent_units: Zone pairs, dates and complete temporal blocks.
validation_design: Zone pairs, dates and complete temporal blocks. Verify identifiers before allocating groups; the partition is not executed or frozen by this acquisition.
author_preprocessing: TLC provider-submitted administrative records; data may contain reporting errors and agency/provider processing. Monthly files are retained whole, including flagged, implausible or incomplete records.
prior_analysis_and_limits: TLC trip data have extensive prior literature. Fare totals and trip durations have definitional components; memorizing those does not demonstrate scientific discovery. Anonymous trips do not identify individual travelers, and provider/zone/time effects matter. Twelve 2025 NYC green-taxi Parquets and zone context; operator-reported records contain known anomalies. Trips lack full road/traffic exposure.
missingness: Native blanks, sentinels, absent records and source quality flags are preserved. No imputation performed by the curator. Exact missingness semantics come from source dictionaries/headers; no universal missing-value rule is imposed.
calibration: Use the retained source calibration files/standards and instrument metadata where provided. Absence of an explicit calibration record is not replaced by an assumed calibration.
